profile.headline: Software Engineer at Checkr
profile.summary: I am a software engineer looking to further develop my skills and learn new ones.  I currently work with ruby on rails and have previous experience in Python, C++, and Java.

positions.title: Maintenance
positions.description:
Established guest safety by ensuring operational rides through routine ride inspections and hourly
water quality tests
Collaborated with a team of maintenance specialists to minimize ride down time by responding to ride
maintenance issues and resolving them properly

positions.title: Cart Attendant
positions.description:
Collected shopping carts throughout the store and parking lot.
Cleaned bathrooms and replaced trash hourly.
Assisted guests with carrying items to their vehicles.
